visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The First Letter Is Lost
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Reversing hello should print olleh, but the program prints olle.

solution.explanation: Index 0 is the first character, and it is the last one to be appended in a reversed string. The loop condition must include 0 (i >= 0). With i > 0 the loop stops one step early.
